title: Prompting Fairness: Artificial Intelligence as Game Players
benchmark_measurement: This paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It measures an AI's sense of fairness, altruism, greed, and inequality aversion in the context of a utilitarian game (dictator game).
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith.
